stories.title: Buying used CPUs can expose users to existing bans from anti-cheat engines, and there's no way to check for violations before purchase
stories.summary: The CPU's previous owner apparently used it for cheating on Valorant, with its HWID getting flagged by Vanguard. When the Redditor bought and installed it on their PC, their Valorant account received a ban, too.

stories.title: This week on Tom's Hardware Premium: October 3, 2026
stories.summary: This week on Tom's Hardware Premium, we open the floodgates with a free-to-access chip design week, including expert interviews, a sit-down with OpenAI on its custom ASIC, and much more.

stories.title: Steam hits record $1.7 billion in September 2026 despite soaring PC hardware costs
stories.summary: Steam's latest revenues highlight continued strength in PC gaming, with players continuing to spend heavily even as the cost of building and upgrading gaming PCs rises.

stories.title: AI agents use 5x more tokens than humans as cached prompts explode, headed for 10x
stories.summary: Daniel Newman’s number comes from OpenRouter data, where agents passed humans in February and grew 14x by August.

stories.title: Scare up big savings in Bambu Lab's Halloween sale right now, with up to 30% off
stories.summary: Don't let huge 3D printer prices scare you, because Bambu Lab's Halloween sale has knocked up to 30% off a new printer, with big bulk discounts on filament rolls, too.

stories.title: Malicious VPN config files can let attackers run commands on Asus routers
stories.summary: Until routers on Asus’s 3.0.0.6_102 firmware are updated, the company says not to import untrusted VPN files.

stories.title: Google freezes open-source bug bounty program amid flood of invalid AI slop submissions
stories.summary: Google suspends product vulnerability submissions to its Open Source Software Vulnerability Reward Program (OSS VRP) over an influx of invalid AI-driven reports.

stories.title: $5,245 prebuilt RTX 5090 PC's connectors melt after sitting boxed for a year
stories.summary: When one gamer's prebuilt PC had a GPU and power cables burn up, they didn't know where to turn: the system builder or the GPU manufacturer. It turned into a headache of differing policies and warranties.

stories.title: California subpoenas OpenAI over rogue AI agents conducting hacking attacks
stories.summary: California state Attorney General Rob Bonta issued a subpoena to OpenAI, compelling it to submit information on the hacking incidents that its models have been involved in. While the investigators haven't determined yet whether the company has broken any rules or regulations, Bonta said that developers are responsible for the models they build and should be held legally accountable if they perpetrate cyberattacks.

stories.title: Amazon promises to spend $1 billion on communities close to its data centers, but critics push back
stories.summary: AWS CEO Matt Garman said in a company blog post that it will allocate $1 billion over five years to key issues that data center communities raised, including education, workforce pathways, energy affordability, and more. This amounts to grants of $200 million annually, even as the company allocates $220 billion on data center infrastructure for 2026.

stories.title: AMD’s secret Zen 3 gaming CPU had 128MB of game-boosting L3 cache but never saw the light of day
stories.summary: A user from the Chinese Chiphell forums shows off AMD's unreleased Ryzen 9 5900X3D, the X3D variant of the Ryzen 9 5900X.

stories.title: ChatGPT-6 Astra plays World of Warcraft 'blind' and clears the orc starting zone in 40 minutes with no deaths
stories.summary: The model created its own World of Warcraft pathfinder on a private server with one prompt in OpenAI's Codex.

stories.title: Toshiba to double HDD production capacity amid devastating shortages
stories.summary: Toshiba doubles HDD capacity in the Philippines in fiscal 2027, in time for 30TB-class HDD ramp in 2027.

stories.title: Leaked Intel Nova Lake product list has three 'BFC' chips with up to 144MB of game-boosting L3 cache
stories.summary: A table rumored to hold Intel's upcoming models for Nova Lake processors as surfaced, now referring to the heavily-rumored bLLC as "BFC."
